name: Your Friends & Neighbors
description: When a financial titan suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.

videos.title: This Is What Happens
videos.overview: After losing his high-powered job, Coop attends a neighbor's barbecue, where he faces his ex-wife Mel and makes a surprising choice.

videos.title: Deuce
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful job interview, Coop pawns a stolen watch.

videos.title: Theoretical Herpes
videos.overview: Nick throws a party for the neighborhood men, leading to tension between Coop and Paul. The women take a self-defense class.

videos.title: Literal Dragons
videos.overview: An unlikely alliance begins. Nick throws Mel a surprise birthday party, where she connects with Coop.

videos.title: This Tourist Has Balls
videos.overview: Coop and Elena sell a stolen painting. Barney tries to hide his financial struggles from his in-laws. Coop makes a discovery at Sam's home.

videos.title: The Things You Lost Along the Way
videos.overview: After being investigated, Coop sets off on a college tour with Mel and their kids while Elena attempts to get ahold of him.

videos.title: The First Honest Thing
videos.overview: Detective Lin makes a discovery at the crime scene. Coop plays hardball with Kat. Chivo puts Elena in a tough spot.

videos.title: When Did We Become These People?
videos.overview: Coop tries getting back what he's lost. Mel and Sam clash. Coop, Nick, and Barney have a boys' night.

videos.title: We're Here Until We're Not
videos.overview: The arrival of a charming billionaire neighbor disrupts Westmont Village. Coop finds himself with an unexpected new partner in crime.

videos.title: Lady Bits
videos.overview: A surprise party for Tori goes awry, causing a rift in the Cooper family. Sam struggles with her alienation from the community.

videos.title: We Were Never Supposed to Get This Old
videos.overview: Ashe offers Coop a deal he can't refuse. Mel feuds with her neighbors over their new dog. Sam goes on a date.

videos.title: The Bread of Affliction
videos.overview: Hari and Gretchen's Passover seder brings the neighborhood together for wine, food, and drama.

videos.title: Halfway to Invisible
videos.overview: Barney deals with Ashe's audit of Nick's Strong Ass Gym. Coop and Jack travel overseas to woo a big investor. Nick throws a housewarming party.

videos.title: For Everything Else, There Was Bowling
videos.overview: Coop and his family navigate a fraught funeral service and wake.

videos.title: Out East
videos.overview: Coop and Sam attend a wild weekend at Ashe's Hamptons estate. Mel takes things too far in her battle with the neighbors.

videos.title: I Feel Lost Without Me
videos.overview: Mel and Tori face the consequences of their actions. Sam tries to end things with Ashe. Coop is caught between a rock and a hard place.

videos.title: Propaganda from the Cowardly
videos.overview: Alliances are tested when Coop, Barney, and Nick attend a dinner at Ashe's mansion.

videos.title: The Night of the Hunter
videos.overview: In the wake of another shocking scandal, the neighborhood gathers for Father's Day at the country club.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 9 nominations total
